verdict.rationale: First-party Graph docs describe createUploadSession, which uploads byte ranges of a file in sequential requests and lets the transfer resume if the connection drops. The docs also cap single-call PUT uploads at 250 MB, which positions upload sessions as the path for big files. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that resumable uploads survive dropped connections in practice, and documented detail on session expiry, chunk-size rules or retry semantics.
